sources.title: GitHub - Wakoma/OfflineAI: Local/Offline Machine Learning Resources
sources.snippet: OfflineAI Research This repository is intended to be catalog of local, offline, and open-source AI (including machine learning and generative AI) tools and approaches, for enhancing community-centered connectivity and education, particularly in areas without accessible, reliable, or affordable internet.

sources.snippet: Works Offline Download the AI model once, then translate anywhere — no WiFi, no roaming, no limits.

sources.title: Offline AI Translator - Chrome Web Store
sources.snippet: Overview The Chrome Offline Translate Plugin provides fast, high-quality translation directly inside your browser, without sending any text to external servers. Powered by Chrome Built-in AI, all translation happens locally on your device, ensuring maximum privacy, zero data leakage, and reliable performance even without an internet connection.

sources.title: Offline AI Translator | Private & Secure Multi-Language Tool
sources.snippet: Our Offline AI Translator breaks this cycle by downloading the intelligence to your device, ensuring absolute confidentiality for sensitive or proprietary text.
